### Onboarding Tasks

- Join the [Developer Development Discord](https://discord.gg/aNfn8DNEMx)
- Install the [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) tools to support Python development
- Using `uv`, install [Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, and/or 3.14](https://www.python.org/) on your laptop
  - Install the full Python version supporting C and Rust binding and SQLite 3
  - Ensure that you can switch between different versions of Python
- Use your operating system's package manager or [asdf-vm](https://asdf-vm.com/) or [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/) to
install the node package manager and all JavaScript programming tools
- Access both the [Fuzzing Book (FB)](https://www.fuzzingbook.org/) and the [Debugging Book
(DB)](https://www.debuggingbook.org/)
  - Fork the GitHub repositories for these two books
  - Clone the forked GitHub repositories to your workstation
  - Use `uv pip` to install each books' dependencies
  - Run a local Jupyter Lab server that can access a book's Jupyter notebooks
  - Correctly run the Jupyter notebook for at least one chapter in FB and DB
- Locate and bookmark the [Software Engineering at Google](https://abseil.io/resources/swe-book) book
- Install the [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) system for scientific and technical publishing
- Learn how to use [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) to create a [web site](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/) with
executable Python code
- Install Quarto's plugin for [VSCode](https://quarto.org/docs/editors/vscode/) or your chosen text editor
- Learn how to clone and run the source code in the course Web site
- Practice using and begin to understand the input, output, and behavior of
commands like `uv run quarto preview` and `uv run quarto render`
- Practice all of tasks in the [GitHub Flow](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/using-github/github-flow) model
for software development
